# ask-koki

> Ask which skills from this repo fit a project and how to introduce them. A router over the agent-kit inventory — detects project signals, reads the curated catalog, proposes a small set of skills with install strings, and explains how they compose. Invoke explicitly when setting up a project's apm.yml or deciding which skills a task needs.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install HukuKaich0u/agent-kit/skills/meta/ask-koki
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - HukuKaich0u/agent-kit/skills/meta/ask-koki
```

then run `apm install`.

### Any agentskills.io-compatible agent

This is an [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) skill — a portable
`SKILL.md` folder that works with Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Gemini CLI,
Cursor, and other [compatible agents](https://agentskills.io/clients).

With the [`skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) CLI (installs into
every detected agent's skills directory):

```bash
npx skills add HukuKaich0u/agent-kit --skill ask-koki
```

Or copy the folder in directly:

```bash
npx degit HukuKaich0u/agent-kit/skills/meta/ask-koki ~/.claude/skills/ask-koki
```

See [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) for what this skill does and when to use it.
